Class CartographicOpticsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.CartographicOpticsHelper
public final class CartographicOpticsHelper extends Object

CartographicOpticsHelper

Lambertian topographical hillshading, diurnal astronomical solar terminator shading, and alpha-composite color blending calculations for planetary cartographic views.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • computeHillshadeFactor

      public static double computeHillshadeFactor(H3Cell cell, boolean showHillshading, H3Service h3Service, Map<Long,H3Cell> cellMap)
      Computes Lambertian hillshading illumination factor based on topographical elevation gradients.
      Parameters:
      cell - target hexagonal cell
      showHillshading - whether hillshading is enabled
      h3Service - H3 spatial index service
      cellMap - mapping of cell indexes to cells
      Returns:
      illumination multiplier factor
